info.title: Ostiary auth API
info.description: The endpoints of the Ostiary auth app, served under /api/auth. Generated from Better Auth's openAPI plugin with every optional feature on. Admin endpoints need a platform admin's session; client management and API key management are not served over HTTP.

tags.name: Core
tags.description: Email and password sign-up and sign-in, sessions, the user's profile and linked accounts.

tags.name: Username
tags.description: Sign-in with a username instead of an email address.

tags.name: Email codes
tags.description: Sign-in with a 6-digit code sent by email.

tags.name: Passkeys
tags.description: WebAuthn passkeys: registration, sign-in and management.

tags.name: Two-factor
tags.description: Authenticator app (TOTP), email codes and backup codes as a second step.

tags.name: Google One Tap
tags.description: Sign-in with Google One Tap, when it is on in the admin console.

tags.name: Multiple accounts
tags.description: Several signed-in accounts in one browser.

tags.name: Text messages
tags.description: Sign-in with a code texted to a phone number the account verified (TWILIO_* set), and adding one.

tags.name: OAuth and OpenID Connect
tags.description: The authorization server: authorization, tokens, introspection, revocation, UserInfo, consents and client registration.

tags.name: Device sign-in
tags.description: RFC 8628 device authorization grant for CLIs and TVs.

tags.name: Signing keys
tags.description: The JSON Web Key Set that verifies ID tokens and JWT access tokens.

tags.name: API keys
tags.description: Checks an API key for a resource server.

tags.name: Enterprise SSO
tags.description: OIDC and SAML 2.0 sign-in per organization.

tags.name: SCIM
tags.description: SCIM 2.0 provisioning, authenticated with an organization's SCIM token.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: User management. Needs a platform admin's session (and two-factor when REQUIRE_ADMIN_2FA is on).
